pairs.l: 5 — thought subject grades were equally important?
7 — taught a sport where it wasn't popular?
9 — had an influence on their career?
10 — was good at demonstrating what to do?
11 — was forced to change their approach by the players?
12 — brought about a dramatic improvement in results?

r1.exp: 1=D (Dora: 'learnt all about nutrition in sport'). 2=C (Chris: 'we got thrashed every week'). 3=F (Florence: 'stay behind and pick up litter if we had lost'). 4=B (Bella: 'We thought it was hilarious... However, she was truly amazing'). 5=E (Ed: 'expected us to get good marks in school studies too'). 6=A (Alan: 'push us to the limit... punishing schedule'). 7=E (Ed: 'basketball was definitely a minority sport'). 8=C (Chris: 'playing systems that nobody else had used for decades'). 9=B (Bella: 'Her example inspired me to study to become a PE teacher'). 10=D (Dora: 'absolutely brilliant at showing us how to play all the various shots'). 11=F (Florence: 'players threatened to report her to principal. She calmed down after that'). 12=A (Alan: 'We went from completely rubbish to one of the top teams in the area').

r13.exp: 'Made the whole exercise rather QUESTIONABLE, in my view' = skeptičan = A (Sceptical).

r14.exp: 'Distressing that poverty and hopelessness existed SIDE BY SIDE WITH tremendous wealth' = nepravda situacije = C (injustice of the situation).

r15.exp: 'She hadn't noticed there were so many UNTIL her financial advisor pointed it out' = nije znala = A.

r16.exp: 'Some are UNSOLD STOCK' = novi/neprodani primjerci, čega nema u regularnim antikvarijatima = D (they have new books).

r17.exp: 'Cases of corruption very much the EXCEPTION rather than the rule... medical advances show donations put to GOOD USE' = doniranje je uglavnom dobra stvar = B.

r18.exp: 'Charities being run ALONG THE LINES OF TOP COMPANIES' = profesionalnije poslovanje = D (will become more professional).

r19.exp: 'Essential to plan well in advance. (19)___. The greater the detail...' → D: With it, you can monitor that you're keeping up with deadlines. 'With it' = plan; nastavlja se na detaljnost plana. (F pripada r24 — 'lives at stake' → 'focus on the people'.)

r20.exp: 'Sudden weather change... change of route. (20)___. Basically, it acts as a reference point.' → E: This is when it is crucial to have a detailed plan to refer to. U takvim situacijama plan je ključan.

r21.exp: 'Don't take solely upon yourself to make the change. (21)___. This way, it gets discussed from all angles.' → A: It is essential to involve everyone in dealing with the problem.

r22.exp: 'Need to rely on your team. (22)___. Everyone expected to act according to plan.' → G: With a plan, there's a much reduced need for the leader to tell everyone what to do. Plan smanjuje potrebu za vođinim instrukcijama.

r23.exp: 'Plan can't cover every detail. Unrealistic to think otherwise. (23)___. A safe return is imperative.' → C: you must always keep the final aim in mind, and be careful how you define it. Finalni cilj = sigurni povratak.

r24.exp: 'Wouldn't have been able to get there without a detailed plan. (24)___. Focus not just on details but particularly on the PEOPLE.' → F: it is a dangerous exercise and your team members' lives are at stake. Opasnost → fokus na ljude.

r25.exp: 'Warn ships AWAY from treacherous shores' — frazalni glagol: warn away from = upozoriti da se udalje od.

r26.exp: 'The most famous lighthouse EVER' — 'ever' u superlativnoj konstrukciji: the most... ever = ikad.

r27.exp: 'Not as essential... AS they used to be' — komparativna konstrukcija: as... as (jednako... kao).

r28.exp: 'Number has DECLINED considerably' — 'decline' = smanjiti se (za broj/količinu). 'Failed' ne ide uz number.

r29.exp: 'With a view to SAVING them from neglect' — fiksna konstrukcija: with a view to + gerund.

r30.exp: 'Used for commercial PURPOSES' — fiksna kolokacija: for commercial purposes (u komercijalne svrhe).

r31.exp: 'Ready to FACE the challenge' — fiksna kolokacija: face a challenge = suočiti se s izazovom.

r32.exp: 'Located NEAR popular tourist resorts' — 'near' = blizu (uz imenicu bez prijedloga). 'Close to' bi tražilo 'to', 'next to' bi tražilo 'to'.

r33.exp: 'Reached ITS culmination' — posvojni 'its' odnosi se na 'space race' (neživo).

r34.exp: 'A new space race AHEAD of us' — 'ahead of us' = pred nama (u budućnosti).

r35.exp: 'Commercial space flights, WHICH will be technically feasible' — relativna zamjenica 'which' u ne-restriktivnoj surečenici (uz zarez).

r36.exp: 'Who can afford this, EXCEPT for the immensely rich' — 'except (for)' = osim, izuzev.

r37.exp: 'A large NUMBER of deposits' — 'a large number of + množina' = velik broj.

r38.exp: 'Could TURN out to be highly profitable' — frazalni glagol: turn out to be = ispostaviti se da je.

r39.exp: 'When THERE is money to be made' — egzistencijalna konstrukcija: there is/are.

r40.exp: 'INSTEAD of reaching for the stars... reaching for big money' — 'instead of' = umjesto.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi s uvodom, razradom i zaključkom. Argumenti ZA premlad: emocionalna nezrelost, nedostatak životnog iskustva, podložnost manipulaciji. Argumenti PROTIV (tj. ZA pravo glasa): demokratsko pravo, plaćaju poreze/vojska, imaju stake u budućnosti. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej zadatak — ručno se ocjenjuje. Raspravni esej (discuss both views + your opinion). Viša razina: složeniji argumenti, akademski stil, bogat vokabular, 200–250 riječi.
